Unresolved compatible auxiliary identities/provider data require explicit completion, not replacement with collection labels or invented quantities. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004` |
| valid_single_basis | all inventory rows | Verify Q > 0 for a unit result, raw original units and conversion before attribution, and the single normalization. At zero Q retain actual burden without a unit result. All cards target per 1 kg reference flow while collection stores raw unnormalized records; original-cohort services use their own Q_c and observed h. No second division, FG manufacture deduction or repeat production. | `jrc-ilcd-2010`; `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual` |
